main_body: A round leaf canopy/bush blob in several greens, seen as a puffy mass with a few brown twig patches. No trunk and no distinct front face.
top_band: none: the column is leaf clumps of mixed light and dark greens from top to bottom, with no distinct top band, front-edge step or separate front face
evidence: The whole sprite is a uniform leafy mound, 48 rows tall, with scattered light and dark clumps and three small brown twig patches. It has no trunk and no lighter horizontal top band stepping down to a shaded front face. It reads as a flat overhead view of foliage, so there is no top-and-front structure. As an organic canopy it could pass as a bush, but a strict reading of the contract gives no top-then-front separation, so it fails.

style.evidence: The candidate uses about 5 greens from light lime to dark green, in leaf clumps with a dark teal-green outline at the edges. This is a dark tone of the neighbouring material, not near-black. The leaf texture is pixel-clumped and has no large flat areas. Compared with the references, it lacks the trunk, branch structure and the clear light-to-shadow volume of the canopy. The shading is more uniform across the whole mass, and the clumps are less defined. It reads as a flat, evenly lit mat of leaves and is a bit thinner than the references, so it fails.
